annotations.title: MCP server check with tool-poisoning screen (paid, x402)

description: Connects to an MCP server the way an agent does, lists its tools, and screens every description an agent would read for hidden instructions. Use it before connecting your agent to an MCP server you do not control. Give the server's URL; returns its tools and every description that tries to instruct the agent reading it. Paid per call: 0.50 USDC on Base over x402, no Agoreum account. Call it without payment to get the terms (an isError result holding the x402 PaymentRequired object), then call again with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"]; the settlement comes back in _meta["x402/payment-response"]. Nothing is charged if the check fails or the payment does not settle. list_agoreum_tools lists all six with examples.
